?! Th-That's a Sand Eagle!

526.original: All right! Just one more Dragon Ball to go!

527.original: We're doing better than I thought we would!

528.original: ...Better? If it wasn't for us, you probably wouldn't have gotten one.

530.original: Come on, guys... We've only got one more to go! Let's go get it!

531.original:
I promised Baba I'd return to the other side by now!

But before I do, I gotta stop by the Kame House!

532.original:
Oh... I guess Master Roshi is probably wondering about us too...

All right, let's make a stop at the Kame House!

533.original: ...I see... So only one more Dragon Ball to go, huh...?

534.original: That's right, but... I gotta return to the other side soon!

535.original:
I'd like to be able to keep you here until all the Dragon Balls are found.

Or even until you fight off the Saiyans...

But even King Kai's power won't be able to allow that...

536.original:
Don't worry, Gohan!

I'll be training at King Kai's place and be back in half a year stronger than ever!

540.original: Good luck with the last Dragon Ball everyone!

542.original: ...Well, let's go get that last Dragon Ball...

543.original: Wait a second... I'll check the Dragon Radar!

545.original: The Dragon Ball is getting closer to us!

548.original: I'll take those Dragon Balls, thank you very much!

550.original:
Hello, boys! You've embarrassed me enough in the past!

Now I can add your Dragon Balls to mine to make seven!

551.original: Shu! Mai! We're going back to my new Pilaf Castle to call forth Shenron!

552.original: That's great, sir! Now you'll be able to realize your long time dream of world domination!

553.original: Once you have control of the world, you'll then be popular with the girls...

555.original: Sir! We have the Dragon Balls, so we should leave as soon as possible!

556.original:
Oh, yeah!

Wah hah hah! See you suckers!

558.original: How can we let them do that?! Let's go after them now!

559.original: OK... Well, he did say something about his new castle...

562.original: I don't know how we let such fools take the Dragon Balls from us... Let's hurry up and get them back!

570.original:
...Probably something to slow us down...

We gotta catch up to them before they summon Shenron!

571.original:
Now you've done it. You've just signed your own death warrant!

I think I'll kill you first now. Ready to die?

572.original:
Chiaotzu... This match is for you...

I'm gonna join you after this... I don't wanna leave you alone.

573.original: Sir! What shall we do once we have control of the world?!

574.original: We'll become popular with the ladies, of course...! Gee hee hee!

576.original: *Cough cough...* We'll contribute loads of money to all of the poor children in the world, of course!

577.original: Um, sir? That doesn't seem very evil...

578.original:
...

Shut up! First things first, we're taking over the world! Are you ready?!

581.original: We're here to take back the Dragon Balls!

582.original: You impudent fools! I'm going to tear you limb from limb!

584.original: One... Two... Three... OK! We've got all seven!

585.original: Let's take them back to Master Roshi!

586.original: All right... So, what should we do with these guys?

587.original: We'll leave them... We've seen the extent of their evil deeds...

589.original:
Hey! You did it!

This is all of them, isn't it?!

590.original: Yes. Now we have everything ready for when we wish back Goku...

591.original:
...We're going to return to training...

We've lost precious time... There's still a lot of work to be done with the time left...

593.original:
Of course.

None of you could give him the training needed to unlock his real power...

595.original: ...I'll go with you to train, Piccolo!

596.original:
Well, that's that...

Now that it's settled, enough of this standing around!

Let's go, Gohan!

598.original: We're also still in the middle of training... We'll return to Kami's Lookout and pick up where we left off!
